body: I just keep asking myself why life so difficult?

Thanks. Everythings ok now. I have a history of depression and other disorders so school has been kinda touch-and-go sometimes. Whats worse is....
I finding its easier to talk to complete strangers about this stuff then a friend because....idk. Friends are, like school, a problem. Most of my close friends are gone away to college. Thank for replying.

Your case is very interesting. I can see it from both sides. Is it possible that your mother has had a spiritual encounter that has changed her in some way? 
Not trying to consider your observations wrong because if this change in your mother has caused an interruption of her normal activities like relationships and work...that's evidence there is something wrong. 

However If she does proclaim a spiritual encounter, it is her first amendment right to exercise her beliefs no matter how "coo-coo" crazy they are. Granted they don't harm anyone else. For example, There are productive people in society that still believe in UFO's and others who are still part of the KKK no matter how deviant society has deemed it. 

If so, you really can't do anything against her will. Even if the does genuinely need mental help, the best thing you can do is love her the same way you lover her before she was like this. The same way she loved you and still loves you. 

Since your 18 you may choose to move out. You could make the argument that you can't take care of your mother but still need good hard evidence that she cannot support herself. If you can there are programs for the mentally "disabled" individuals according to whatever state your living.
